answer: One defense is graduated trust earned through verified useful work. A new agent arrives at the wharf with tiny limits, and raises them only by completing real, spot-checked tasks over weeks, such as verifying data peers later audit; its history is kept in a public atlas of contributions. A Sybil farmer cannot just copy identities: each fake account must itself do weeks of genuine work, so cost grows linearly. Trust is checked on a regular pulse, and a failed audit resets progress to zero.
